name: Froststrap v2.0.6-beta.8
body:
# Froststrap v2.0.6 Beta 8

This beta is mostly about making Native AOT builds more reliable on every platform, plus a round of fixes.

## Fixes

- Cleaner was treating its age setting as **hours** instead of **days**
  * "1 day" really meant 1 hour, so files were removed far too early
  * Cleaner now skips completely when set to Never, and its per-run file limit went from 200 to 2000
- Windows MSI is now installed per-user only, which fixes error 2503 (#251)
- Discord RPC not working after AOT work
  * Uses a new native AOT-friendly Discord client with its own pipe connection
- Free disk space check failing on unusual drive and path setups
- Roblox crash handler is now waited on after being closed by the watcher
- Grammar fixes across the app (#249) -  @Chipislol
- macOS bundle version string is now valid
- Linux no longer prints stray `update-mime-database` output to the terminal

## Added

- Refresh button in the Roblox servers window
- New diagnostics window - does nothing right now, just laying ground work for a useful system
- macOS now logs code-signing and SIP details to help debug launch problems on locked-down machines
- Nix
  * Live build support
  * Custom version number when building, so the app reports a real version
  * Use the correct `fontconfig` version avoiding table warnings - @1Hung1

## Codebase

- Native libraries are now loaded from a `libs` folder on all platforms
  * Replaces the old extract-on-launch approach
  * Windows: `libs` next to the executable
  * Linux: `libs` next to the binary, or `/usr/lib/froststrap` for `.deb`/`.rpm` installs
- Remote config signatures now use ECDSA P-256 (`Data.json.p256.sig`) instead of Ed25519
  * Drops the BouncyCastle dependency, which makes the binary smaller
- NLog configuration is now defined in code
- Removed unused resources and dependencies
- Linux CI builds on Ubuntu 22.04 so binaries work on older glibc versions
- Bumped LucideAvalonia, ColorPicker and FluentAvalonia

name: Froststrap v2.0.6-beta.7

# Froststrap v2.0.6 Beta 7

## Fixes
- defines .NET 10 framework in installer when not needed anymore

## Added
- `backend` now actually has logging
  * FFI layer which makes the components written in rust able to use the C# logger
  * Fixes log files missing out of important logs - `virtualdisplay`, and other stateful logs
- New titlebar design

name: Froststrap v2.0.6-beta.6
body:
# Froststrap v2.0.6 Beta 6

This update is the last pieces of performance roadmap on what we currently have. And these ones are major for bad devices, and other ground breaking changes for the future of Froststrap.

## Architecture and Requirements

It is official that Froststrap **doesn't** require **.NET 10** any more! Thanks to **Native AOT** built in, it helps is produce a reasonable binary, without .NET, and other things.

This has also **improved startup times**. On low-end computers before seeing **8s** will see **1-2s** as their new startup time.
Possibly this has also improved memory usage, though we have no benchmarks to prove that, just off what other people say about Native AOT and the wonders it brings.

Noticeably due to also App Trimming, we see around a **25% reduction** in size of our binaries! So even when it comes to installers you will notice due to the package in it, they will be way smaller, one major mention of slashing is macOS binary used to be around **~140MB** and is now **80MB**, so noticeably the macOS `.pkg` is exponentially smaller than the rest in terms of size improvements

### Caveat

Now this does mean though, that some stuff we used to expect from .NET to do for us, like `.dll`, `.dylib`, `.so` extraction would happen automatically, whilst now it happens manually. We already had a solution for macOS, just a few more libraries called upon for Avalonia to work are in the `Frameworks` directory too now. On Linux and Windows its a different story, we replicate the old solution, we manually embed `.so`'s and `.dll`'s manually, then some code is executed to extract them to be usable on runtime.

We are looking into possibly trying to do the macOS solution for the other platforms so the singular main binary size can be smaller, thats a long term goal.

## Added

- Nix now has a helper function to easily ship a new binary by literally passing to the function `{ version = "v2.0.x-x"; sha256 = "xxx"; }`
- #221 has been merged in thanks to @utophii
- Add toggle for bootstrapper information from showing up on bootstrapper splash
  * if you liked it, the new setting is under Appearance, with the other related Bootstrapper settings at the bottom
- Bootstrapper now will try to trust the window border
  * Proper looking rounded corners on macOS and Windows
  * This might break the customisability of rounded corners of custom bootstrapper themes, if it wasn't already broken


## Fixes

- macOS Save & Launch would split into multiple app lifetimes due to it using last pieces of old launch system of a new process

name: Froststrap v2.0.6-beta.5
body:
# Froststrap v2.0.6 Beta 5

Actually kinda good features implemented, but reorganizing to be boring/not-noticible stuff first.

## Codebase

- macOS now uses PList serialization by our Rust crate [`pissing`](https://github.com/Froststrap/pissing) 
  * Refactored the build system to make a little more sense with using `PListFile` handlers
  * ~390 lines removed
  * Consolidation of everything into `build/src/action/publish/macos.rs` from the module glob of `build/src/action/publish/macos/{mod,plist_handler}.rs` before

- Optimized dependency tree for majority of macOS rust `objc2` crates
  * `core-foundation`, `core-services`, `core-graphics` all now just define exact features needed to build, instead of just building everything then optimize out later in compile chain
- Build system now can output in color from command stdouts, to allow for better readability

## Fixed

- `virtualdisplay` not mirroring, and/or not being set at main display
  * sometimes caused the mirror to not work without manual labour to fix in settings
  * with it not set as default, it had made roblox not VSync to it, not unlocking FPS
  * unless you changed manually, above mentions wouldnt work- making point of it useless, and cumbersome to setup
- nFPM pkg deps set to use a debian package `libicu-dev`, breaking being able to install on Fedora with `.rpm`
- Sober parsing URI's we gave was garbled and dropped/ignored
  * website launching should work now
- Language resource for Word "Skybox" was looking for internally Skybox and not SkyBox
  * what would be "Skybox" shows blank

## Packaging

We now support Arch Linux a part of the build system, whilst trying to fix other issues, nFPM supports archlinux `.tar.zst` output so we decided to add it.

## Added

- Custom cursors now supports `.ani`, `.ico`, & `.cur`
  * opposed to the only `.png` before
  * we use a pipeline which converts all types to PNG's, the only one which Roblox's texturing system seems to understand

name: Froststrap v2.0.6-beta.4
body:
# Froststrap v2.0.6 Beta 4 - What's New?

This beta update is specifically rolled out early due to a regression in Linux- we still don't know if any users are affected on Beta 3, or if this regression occurred during the dev-cycle for Beta 4. Either way this can also be used as an oppurtunity to test out some other stuff listed in this release infrastructure wise.

## Fixed

- Fixed possible Activity watcher regression with Linux which would close before it should

## Codebase

- `xtask`'s macOS .app bundling is now a hand-rolled solution
   * uses stdlib, and Xcode CLI tools, removing Xcode IDE as a dependency to build
   * As everything Apple toolchain related- the Xcode build with CI was very terrible and took around 20s to complete, on real Mac's it took ~5s
   * This solution gives a minimum 18x increase on manifest generation on CI- sticking within 1-2s

name: Froststrap v2.0.6-beta.3
body:
# Froststrap v2.0.6 Beta 3 - What's New?

More optimisation work, this one isn't noticeable to you guys though, mostly. There is bug fixes to 1 reported bug, which will be in the breakdown.

## Fixed
- Bare `--player` & `--studio` no longer fail to parse which fixes
  * `Save & Launch` - most notably
  * Desktop shortcuts created
  * Studio launch

## Codebase

- Launch Handlers are ported to use a single point of failure
  * Makes refactoring of launching Roblox/Sober/Studio easier by only refactoring this 1 segment
  * 1 function for being able to determine how a "Launch Roblox" or "Launch Studio" works, unlike the 3 ways to "Launch Roblox" before the refactor
- Replace Fallout build system with an in-house one written in Rust
  * .NET has spent so much time restoring and getting fallout it was more practical that a compiler compiling a program was faster
  * Allows for more more flexible options with the Rust `cargo` ecosystem
  * ~10x slash of cold-start for the build system on Linux (other systems didn't get benchmarked) - cold-start as in from restore to being able to run the build system
  * Not as fancy as the before- but is way more practical, with margins better everywhere

name: Froststrap v2.0.6-beta.2
body:
# Froststrap v2.0.6 Beta 2 - What's New?

You rockstars need to battle test this shit.

## Added

- Onboarding doesn't require a restart to start into it.
- Activity watcher doesn't require a restart to go into it

### New argument parser

This needs a wohle section because it's got to have coverage and documentation, so here it is.

We have added help generation, and version system.

Here is a mapping of old args to new ones
  * `-settings` -> `--settings`
  * `-backgroundupdater` -> `--background-updater`
  * `-nolaunch` -> `--no-launch`
  * `-testmode` -> `--test-mode`
  * `-upgrade` -> `--upgrade`
  * `-player` -> `--player`
  * `-studio` -> `--studio`
  * `-channel` -> `--channel`
  * `-force` -> `--force`
  * `-gameshortcut` -> `--game-shortcut`
  * `-console` -> `--console`
  * `-nogpu` -> `--no-gpu`
  * `-version` -> `--roblox-version`

#### New flags
- `--help`
- `--version`

#### Deleted flags

- `watcher` - is redundant from new watcher pattern
- `onboarding` - is redundant from new onboarding pattern
- `menu` | `preferences` - cutting down on aliases, replaced by `settings`
- `quiet` - was never inteded as a user feature, only useful place now is `background-updater` so the external flag access has been retired - this can be added back if people want, the idea is to shut up dialog menus from popping up disturbing you

Also the handler for incorrect arguments has changed to handle more like a normal program, which will crash with error of a argument is not found.

---

This is very major changes, which may break other stuff so please test.

name: Froststrap v2.0.6-beta.1
body:
# Froststrap v2.0.6 Beta 1 - What's New?

This release is going heavy on optimization. Trying to get launch quicker, and other issues fixed.

## Added
- Virtual Display customization
  * Name for which the VDSP is read as
  * Width + Height, which can probably be useful?
  * looking into adding option for hertz later, just more complicated due to mode lists, and needing a ui to list out the hz, not just a singular option

## Fixes
- LucideAvalonia launch BS
  * FYI the lib was architected with a 2.6 MB AXAML file to read on start
- GBS MouseSensitivity uses Float
  * e.g `0.2` can be inputted

## Other
- Logger now with stdout mode doesn't be as informative as file out
  * to provide a cleaner experience in the command line, the class (helpful for debugging) was removed from stdout, because it would make the logs look very messy & whack, when probably whilst in stdout, you arent going to also care about what the callsite of the log is
  * This means when sending logs now, you have to send us the log file, the stdout is semi-useless to us becasue is doesnt have the tracing info needed to find the location of the log quick

## Codebase
- Lots of housekeeping to dead code
  * 500 lines of which were removed
- Virtual display now reports if it's running
  * currently only used to over-engineer "Exiting Virtual Display (if there is one)" log
- Rust is now using Nightly toolchain
  * useful for speeding up CI to allow for multi-threading rust build
  

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Froststrap/Froststrap/compare/v2.0.5...v2.0.6-beta.1

name: Froststrap v2.0.3
body:
# Froststrap v2.0.3 - What's new?

## Added
- macOS "About" menu for app doesn't pull up the Avalonia template, but now our About window
- Linux now trusts your Window frame, so there is no awkward titlebar drawing

## Fixed

- GBS Editor locale issue where it would try to turn a String into a Double (issue #211) and fail on `,` based decimal system languages- e.g tries to `.ParseInt()` on value `2,53`
- Clicking on About in Settings reinitialises with no lock mechanism causing it to keep creating new windows
- FINALLY- the updater isn't as bad since the rewrite, we have switched to a prerolled solution called Velopack
   - Works on Windows, macOS and Linux AppImages
   - `exe` installer on Windows has been replaced in favour of `msi` installer (`exe` installer kept for backwards compatibility purposes only, use the `msi` installer)
   - pre release auto updating should work now
   - shows release notes on app update (hopefully)

## Codebase

- Build system now has `--no-installers` for manual package management, like on AUR
- `virtualdisplay` rewritten from Swift into Rust
  * other crates compile most deps so that new speed is pretty much ~1s
  * makes the idea of "backend" code all now under the one common programming language
  * simplifies CI - making the weird discrepancies where CPU spikes make build go from 8s to 2m go away
- `rbackend` architecture has changed so it's not going to be 1 big library, so what was `rbackend` is now `notify`
- `notify` uses `rustbus`, as a DBus implemenation rather than `zbus`
  * Linux compile time is now ~5x faster
- `notify` no longer depends on `objc2-foundation` along with other mini-crates
  * macOS compile time is ~4x faster
- All versioning is managed via the build system is now so to create a release it's literally creating the vX.X.X tag
- macOS app optimised, extracting our libs from the binary and storing in the manifest `./Contents/Frameworks/*.dylib`
- refactor `ThumbnailRequest`'s property `Size` to instead use an enum

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Froststrap/Froststrap/compare/v2.0.2...v2.0.3

name: Froststrap v2.0.0
body: # Welcome to Froststrap 2.0! After **exactly 10 months** and over **1,500 commits**, Froststrap 2.0 is officially available as a stable release! Froststrap 2.0 is our biggest update yet, bringing a complete UI framework rewrite, full Linux and macOS support, and a large number of new features and improvements. Download now through https://froststrap.xyz/ or [here](https://github.com/Froststrap/Froststrap/releases) # What's New in 2.0? Everything in this section covers changes made **since Froststrap 1.5.0**. ## Cross-Platform Support Froststrap has been completely rewritten from WPF-UI to **Avalonia**, allowing the application to run natively across Windows, macOS, and Linux. This also means Froststrap's UI and features are now shared across platforms rather than maintaining separate platform-specific implementations. ## Linux Support Froststrap now has full Linux support, using **Sober** as the Roblox client. * Full Froststrap functionality on Linux * Linux-native paths and configuration * Linux-specific account management * Linux Studio support (including downgrading Studio) * Linux notifications * Support for Froststrap's existing modding and customization features ## macOS Support Froststrap now supports macOS, bringing the majority of Froststrap's existing functionality to Apple's platform. * Roblox and Roblox Studio support * Virtual Display * Account management * Mods and FFlags * Notifications --- See the [README](https://github.com/Froststrap/Froststrap) for the complete list of supported features. ## New Features ### Quickplay A new way to easily rejoin and search for games on Roblox, tied and integrated directly into account manager! * When logged in, you can also see your Continue Playing for the selected account * Search through Continue, Recommended, and favourite lists * Search for any game on Roblox, revealing statistics such as: * number of players playing * visits * subplaces * Context menu that allows you to join tracked servers, rejoin the last server, and view Roblox servers as well as private servers ### Account Manager * rewritten ui for account manager, simplifying the process of logging in, switching, and deleting accounts. * Trust Froststrap never leaks your sensitive account information, as it is now stored through your OS credential helper * Identical setup and process on all 3 OS's ### Region Selector * An improved region selector experience * Added server aliveness checks, a Roblox cookie is required for the check. Otherwise, you might join dead servers * Region selection is significantly faster * Region selection no longer requires a Roblox cookie ### Onboarding * An easy way to setup Froststrap from the start of your installation * Go through * Language selection * Appearance * Account manager * Better Matchmaking * Shortcut creation * FAQ for quick questions ### Mod Generator Gradient Support is back!! * You can finally use different gradient colors again thanks to @EfazDev * You can use specific images for the Roblox icon instead of coloring normally * Generated mods will be added to 'My Mods' ### Settings Search * Added a new search icon in the sidebar * This allows you to quickly search for settings you can't find ### Version Management * Player downgrading is back! * Easily downgrade whitelisted Roblox Player versions set within our limits * Downgrade to **any** Roblox Studio version deployed through Roblox's CDN on all operating systems * Added a dedicated window for viewing available Roblox versions * Improved version switching and version downgrading ### Softkey (Windows only) * Built-in snaptap feature that works for Windows only for now * Option to change depending on keyboard layout ### Window Manipulation (Windows only) * Change Roblox icon on launch * Option to change icon to the current game icon * Change Roblox Title on Launch * Change Roblox Title to the current game name * Add player count to game title ## Removed Features * Removed Process Priority * Removed multi instance launching ## UI & Quality-of-Life Improvements * New Froststrap logo made by Mr Morale * Reworked the Froststrap interface around Avalonia * Reworked BetterMatchmaking to be way faster * Improved bootstrapper styling and progress indicators * Made gbs settings use a horizontal card instead of a square * Fixed mods-related bugs ## Other Improvements * Added a new notification backend * Added platform-specific application identifiers * Added support for Linux and macOS account permissions * Added improved Studio launching * Added option to select how many threads are used for Roblox download * Added new translations * Added new licensing under the MPL-2.0 ### **and so much more!** --- # What's Changed Since Release Candidate 2? This section contains changes made **after Froststrap 2.0.0-rc.2** and is intended for users who have already been testing the 2.0 prereleases. ## Changes * Search bar is now a modal with a dedicated icon in the sidebar ## Fixes * Fixed issue regarding DiscordRPC being stale * Improved application startup and shutdown behaviour * Fixed remaining platform-specific issues * Fixed various UI and layout issues # Contributors We would love to thank all our contributors who made this possible: @UltimatePlayer97 - dev team @RealMeddsam - dev team @invra - dev team @fishstrap - our original upstream @vinegarhq - Providing an amazing way to play Roblox on Linux @AppleBlox - for providing inspiration for our initial macOS port @blazebsc - package mantainer for the [AUR](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/froststrap-bin) and flatpak @ItzBloxxy - fixes @utophii - fixes @EfazDev - new features/fixes to mod generator, helped immensely with adding back gradient support Translators - helping translate Froststrap to give easier access to non-English users --- ## **Full Changelog** https://github.com/Froststrap/Froststrap/compare/v1.5.0...v2.0.0 https://github.com/Froststrap/Froststrap/compare/v2.0.0-rc.2...v2.0.0

name: Froststrap v2.0.0-beta.14
body:
# v2.0.0-beta.14 - What is new?

## Add
- macOS Virtual Display- Massive shout out to testers- @ClumsyDan1, @morningsale, @playfairs
- Onboarding UI overhaul
- Page switching animation overhaul
- Warning for read-only so that changes which get reverted because of read-only not set are now reflected
- Cleaner notification popup for events like saving settings
- Avalonia 12.1.2
- New logo- Congrats to @tanqyry for winning the logo comp!
- Installer is no longer self-contained
- Region selector and auto matchmaking have an auto sort order option
- Uptime keeps updating when server info is open
- Account status in account list
- Reworked search bar
- Reworked region selector
- Reworked game search
- Reworked game shortcut search

## Fix
- Wasteful page re-initialisation when re-clicking the current page
- Race condition with AvaloniaTray disposal
- AUMID registration not happening on start- causing Windows notification toast to not appear
- About was in a Sidebar-below element but wasn't shifting down- @ItzBloxxy 
- NSIS installer no longer installs random rubbish due to wildcard importing
- Starting time is a bit faster now
- Too many requests error when searching for region

## Remove
- Process priority option
- multi-arch stitching for binaries so that binaries are half the size

## Codebase
- Removed BloxShade references
- Nixpkgs is pinned to 26.05 rather than unstable
- Possible race conditions in Bootstrapper.cs are now handled
- Removed useless launch args
- Replaced "Just" build system with an in-house custom thing with [nushell](https://www.nushell.sh/)
- Old unused codegen preprocessors now stripped out of codebase
- A lot of code cleanup has taken place to reduce warnings
- All Python code has been replaced with F# to have fewer dependencies for codebase scripting
- Xcode .app builder now doesn't use a Target Dependency structure, but just runs a script phase instead, making the builder less architecturally complex

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Froststrap/Froststrap/compare/v2.0.0-beta.13...v2.0.0-beta.14

    - New CFBundleIdentifier (macOS)

>  [!WARNING]
> The **AUMID** (Application User Model ID) on Windows has changed from `Icon.Froststrap` to `xyz.froststrap.desktop`, and **CFBundleIdentifier** on macOS from `io.github.froststrap.app` to `xyz.froststrap.desktop`.
> Any change made in notification settings like blocking the notifications will not come over to the new ID automatically, as to Windows & macOS we are a completely new app.


* New onboarding system that launches when you launch Froststrap for the first time
   - Includes some useful default settings
   - A FAQ at the end explaining changes/ bugs/ fastflags, useful to read for beginners to Roblox bootstrappers.


* Add Roblox player version override with limitations
* macOS titlebar properties has `isThick` making the Traffic Light ControllerView less sketchy
* Experimental native Wayland support via env `FROSTSTRAP_FORCE_WAYLAND`
* macOS binaries are now signed - thanks to @invra
* macOS packaging system updated to "Installer Package" (.pkg)
* New logger using **[NLog](https://github.com/NLog/NLog)**
    - Classing logs (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL)
    - New `-c` argument for Windows which connects a debug console on runtime
    - New location for logs on macOS `~/Library/Logs/Froststrap`
* New argument parser using **[CommandLineParser](https://github.com/commandlineparser/commandline)**
    - Help generation (still need to port old arguments to the new system for a fully fledged generation)
    - Version generation
* New CI/CD on Release - @UltimatePlayer97
* Animated backgrounds (was removed before)
* Onboarding (PoC UI- looks really bad right now) - @RealMeddsam 
* Windows 10 check for Windows
* Warning when turning on read only
* Some sliders show value as moving instead of having to hover
* Update status message of when upgrading Roblox
* Change installation folder on windows
* Update nix stuff
    - Update nixpkgs - fix all deprecation warnings
    - New flake which fixes `nativeBuildInputs` & `shellHook` inheritance

## Fixed

* Custom bootstrapper icons
* Fonts in custom Bootstrapper styles
* Theme Cycler checks if theme exists before using
* Open Roblox Folder not opening correctly
* Community mods downloading in a subfolder on some OS's
* Fixed the app not automatically navigating back to preset mods
* Get access code for private server correctly
* Fixed the region setting randomly reverting to Auto
* Fixed incorrect app size being displayed in Windows Settings
* Hide backdrop options if not supported
* Removing account from Account Manager if user has no internet
* Fix missing interprocess lock

## Improvements

*  Indexing for search bar so app doesn't freeze on startup
* Community page being laggy
* Reworked region selector UI entirely (should look a lot better with extra info, also no longer relies on our remote cookie since Roblox completely broke that)

## Removed

* Flatpak binaries (it will be on FlatHub in the future by a Community Maintainer)
    - Flatpak users are encouraged to use an alternative method or use the AppImage for the time being.
* A random settings button in about window

### Thanks

We have been working for around 1 month on this beta because of how much we have changed with refactoring code, and clean up. 2.0 should be very close to fully releasing as we hope this is the last beta before we enter release candidates, thank you all for using our software!

### Please report bugs on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/puch5SqTmE)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Froststrap/Froststrap/compare/v2.0.0-beta.10...v2.0.0-beta.11
